correctness.rationale: PASS: The descendant condition is exactly avoidance of 18792 forbidden 3-sets on all 3^4=81 words; independent C++ enumerated this hypergraph from words, not importing source tables. Any possible 13-code can by transitive coordinate/symbol action normalize two words to 0000 and 1^d0^(4-d) for d=1,2,3,4, and independent recursive hypergraph branch-and-bound with valid disjoint-pair/triangle upper bounds exhaustively found no 13-code (all 4 cases). Independent complete enumeration of normalized 12-codes containing 0000 returned 832; double-counting with transitivity gives 832*81/12=5616 labeled. Independent traversal of entire 31104-element (S3)^4 semidirect S4 group separated exactly two orbits of sizes 5184 and 432 with empty intersection, 768 and 64 normalized 0000-containing representatives, stabilizers 6 and 72. Independent program returned INDEPENDENT_EXHAUSTIVE_OK, with different search node counts from source (due to traversal), hence not trusting VERIFY_OK. All positive witnesses satisfy descendant test; 12 maximum is earlier published, new content is census/equivalence.
